description: Change one project setting from a fixed list: the main scene, the viewport size, the window size override, the stretch mode/aspect, the project name and max_fps. Anything else (rendering, physics, autoloads, input map) is refused — use the editor. Values may be sent as strings. Undoable with edit_undo; the editor window and a running game pick most settings up when they start.

value.description: New value; converted to the setting's type.

name: project_setting_set
title: Set project setting
